fieldValues.title: Relation type definition
fieldValues.description: What an edge's type string means, installed as its own entity: the key as stored on an edge, a required label and description, a structural category, which end is source and which is target, the key of its display-only inverse, and optional constraints such as irreflexivity. Relation types form a single flat, repository-global set with no per-Type scoping, and a relation whose type does not resolve in it is a validation error.
fieldValues.notes: It is a vocabulary-substrate specialisation that tightens label and description from optional to required. The canonical seven ship as installed definitions in the core package; custom types use `namespace/name` form and supply their own.
